defs.def: to change sth slightly to make it more suitable for a new set of conditions or to make it work better 调整；调节

ex.s: We learn, adjust, and try again.
ex.t: 我们学习、调整，然后再试一次。

ex.s: The very best communicators are those who know how to adjust their language to match their audience.
ex.t: 最好的沟通者是那些知道如何根据读者调整语言的人。
不过，我们会调整这种影响。

ex.s: On what basis do we “adjust the influence” according to the last paragraph? （    ）
ex.t: 我们“调整影响”基于什么？（根据最后一段）（    ）

ex.s: Their body language lets me know when to adjust class activities, when to intervene, and when to talk to students individually, so they can all get the most out of school.
ex.t: 他们的肢体语言让我知道什么时候调整课堂活动，什么时候干预，什么时候单独与学生交谈，这样他们都可以充分利用学校。

ex.s: He had to adjust his own playing style as a result.
ex.t: 因此，他不得不调整自己的演奏风格。

ex.s: Robutt is just adjusted to act as though it loves you.” “But, Dad, we don’t know what’s inside the dog, or what his feelings are.
ex.t: Robutt只是为了表现得像爱你一样。“但是，爸爸，我们不知道狗里面有什么，也不知道他的感受是什么。

defs.def: to get used to a new situation by changing the way you behave and/or think 适应；习惯

ex.s: Slowly but surely, my efforts to adjust to the new routine paid off.
ex.t: 我努力适应新作息，缓慢但稳步地见到了成效。

ex.s: When Riley moves to a new city, she has a hard time adjusting to her new surroundings.
ex.t: 当莱利搬到一个新的城市时，她很难适应新的环境。

ex.s: Yet there was so much melancholy and so much gentleness spread over all this that she gradually adjusted to it.
ex.t: 然而，所有这一切都弥漫着如此多的忧郁和温柔，以至于她逐渐适应了。

defs.def: to move sth slightly so that it looks neater or feels more comfortable 整理
